ai_summary.text:
プラスアルファ・コンサルティングはテキストマイニングとタレントマネジメントのSaaS企業。テキストマイニングツール「見える化エンジン」とタレントマネジメント「タレントパレット」を主力に、CRM分析SaaSも展開している。

売上171億円（前年比+22.8%）と高い成長率。営業利益64億円（営業利益率37.3%）、純利益33億円。SaaS型の高い収益構造が37%超の営業利益率を実現。ROE22%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率79.4%、財務健全性スコア100点と最高評価の財務。営業CF52億円、FCF50億円とほぼ全額がFCFとして残る。EPS79円に対しPER31.7倍は成長期待、配当29円。人的資本経営の開示義務化でタレントマネジメントの需要は構造的に拡大しており、タレントパレットの高い解約率の低さがストック収益の安定を支えている。なお、EPS78.6円、PER31.7倍、1株当たり配当金29.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Plus Alpha Consulting is a SaaS company for text mining and talent management. It mainly develops the text mining tool "Mieruka Engine" and talent management tool "Talent Palette," and also develops CRM analysis SaaS.  Revenue was  17.1 billion (up 22.8% year-on-year), a high growth rate. Operating profit was  6.4 billion (operating margin 37.3%), and net profit was  3.3 billion. The high SaaS revenue structure realizes an operating margin exceeding 37%. ROE is high at 22%.  It has the highest-rated finances, with an equity ratio of 79.4% and a financial soundness score of 100 points. Almost all of the operating CF of  5.2 billion and FCF of  5.0 billion remains as FCF. A PER of 31.7 times against an EPS of  79 indicates growth expectations, and it has a dividend of  29. The structural expansion of demand for talent management due to the mandatory disclosure of human capital management, and Talent Palette's low churn rate, support the stability of stock revenue. The company promotes management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement, with an EPS of  78.6, a PER of 31.7, and a dividend per share of  29.0.
